title: Savory Umami MSG Garlic Compound Butter
ingredients: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted grass-fed butter, softened at room temperature
1 head roasted garlic, cloves squeezed out (or 3 raw cloves finely grated)
1 tsp miso paste or soy sauce
2 tbsp finely chopped fresh chives or parsley
1/2 tsp flaky sea salt & 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Whip the softened butter in a bowl with a spatula or mixer until light and fluffy.
Fold in the roasted garlic, MSG, miso paste, chopped chives, flaky salt, and black pepper until thoroughly incorporated.
Roll the butter into a tight log using parchment paper or plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Slice coins over hot steaks, roast chicken, steamed vegetables, or crusty bread.
